comparison.objective: Release a hard drive from a spring-pin tool-less carrier and place it on an anti-static mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually deflect and hold a sprung rail while pivoting and sliding a fragile drive off retained pins.
comparison.success_condition: Drive progresses from pin release to full removal and safe placement; broken rails, drops, or shocks permanently score zero.
comparison.reason: The record has no spec versions in the indexed JSON; its complete body supplies the objective, staged scoring, and damage gates. Those establish spring-retainer extraction as different from damper adjustment and dynamic commissioning.
